steps.action: Up the service lift from the loading dock
Into suite 2401 by its west door, and wait two turns there in the dark
Across the suite to the end of the north hall, badge the lab door, four turns, and take the prototype
Back into the suite with the prototype, out of the north hall
Across the suite and down the service lift

plan.pushback: Suite 2401 keeps you out of the halls, but the south hall's glass wall looks into the middle of the suite, and G3 walks that hall. Wait at the west door and see which way G3 is facing before you cross.

steps.action: Down to the east stair from the roof deck
Badge the lab door and take the prototype
Back up to the roof deck

plan.pushback: The east stair lets out into the east hall, and every hall on this floor has a camera with analytics. One look and it's lockdown.

steps.action: In through the Wilshire lobby
Badge the lab door and take the prototype
Out through the lobby

plan.pushback: The Wilshire lobby has facial-recognition turnstiles past the desk. If you go that way, you walk past them twice.

steps.action: Up from the podium garage
Badge the lab door and take the prototype
Back down to the garage

plan.pushback: The garage gate reads plates, and I can't promise its lifts reach floor 24.

steps.action: Up the service lift from the loading dock
Along the north hall, badge the lab door, four turns, and take the prototype
Back down the service lift

plan.pushback: The north hall is the short way, but C1 and C2 watch it and they have analytics: one sighting and the floor goes to lockdown. Cut through suite 2401 instead.
